parent_objective: run no-PPO exact repair/projection using the M1072 failed-row projection corpus
blocked_by: M1072 exports a loadable source-labeled failed-row corpus; no projection candidate has been tested with it
invalidates: running another PPO proposal before testing no-PPO projection
running projection with only the old M1037 anchor and not the M1072 failed-row corpus

public_gates: M1073 must not use private holdout
M1073 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M1073 must use the M1072 failed-row projection corpus
M1073 must gate candidates through exact/first-replay checks before any later full public gate
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim full public-gate pass from a first-replay projection probe

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the M1069 proposal can be repaired by exact projection using the M1072 failed-row corpus before any new PPO
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: projection probe only; no promotion, no private holdout, no full public-gate claim unless routed separately
stop_condition: stop if exact gates fail for all candidates
stop if first replay gates fail for all candidates
stop if projection ignores M1072 failed-row corpus
fallback_plan: if a first-replay candidate exists, route to expanded full public gate
if no exact candidate exists, route to exact repair objective audit
if exact passes but replay fails, route to failed-row objective/anchor audit
if projection is base-equivalent, route to PPO recipe redesign
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1072 exports the M1069 failed-row corpus needed by the projection probe

hypothesis: A no-PPO repair/projection probe using the M1072 failed-row corpus can find a candidate that restores exact and first-replay proof constraints after the M1069 medium PPO washout.
success_criteria: no promotion or private holdout occurs
decision_rule: M1073 may only run a no-PPO projection probe and route from its exact/first-replay result. It cannot promote, run PPO, or use private holdout.
